Sandpiper Condo 3B – Oceanfront, Pool & Elevator

Our third-floor condo looks straight out over the dunes. The living room and the main bedroom share a long balcony, so you can hear the waves all night. The building has a heated pool, an elevator, and a private boardwalk to the beach.

The condo sleeps 4: a king bed in the main bedroom and a queen sofa bed in the living room.

What's included
- Heated pool (shared)
- Elevator
- Beach towels
- Smart TV
- Wi-Fi

Wi-Fi network: SandpiperGuest
Wi-Fi password: Colibri2026

Good to know
- Check-in is at 3 PM. You will get the unit number and a parking pass by email.
- No smoking on the balcony or in the unit.
- Maximum 2 cars.
